notes.title: Options Update Patch
notes.content: It seems I forgot to disable a few debugging features when I pushed the latest update. They should all be properly disabled now, and the game should be fully playable again!

notes.title: Options Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, me again!

Today's a special day: it's been exactly one month since Shooting Hurts was first released on Steam, and to celebrate, I wanted to add in a small update that finally adds in an options menu!

The menu is accessible in the pause menu of the game, and allows you to adjust your field of view, mouse sensitivity and the volume of the game. Settings are saved when you apply them and should persist when you close and reopen the game.

I have one or two more settings I'd like to add in later on, but if there are any settings you think would improve your experience with the game, feel free to suggest them in the comments/ discussion boards. They just might make it in!

In the meantime, I hope you all have a better adjusted time with Shooting Hurts!

Good Luck!

notes.title: Achievements Update!
notes.content:
Hi everybody, to celebrate the beginning of October, I've released an update that enables all the achievements! You should now be able to view almost all of them in your steam library. My hope is that this adds nice layer to the game that gives it a little more replay-ability. 

(I personally recommend starting a new game to unlock achievements, if only to prevent a few of them from unlocking all at once)

In addition, I also made a few small tweaks to the game to fix some bugs and improve the experience.

I hope you all enjoy! Good luck!
